title: Health Insurance Sector Crosses ₹1.2 Lakh Crore Premiums
summary: **Sector Growth & Scale:** Total health insurance premium collections grew by ~9% YoY to surpass **₹1.20 Lakh Crore in FY 2025-26** as per IRDAI industry disclo...

items: **Sector Growth & Scale:** Total health insurance premium collections grew by ~9% YoY to surpass **₹1.20 Lakh Crore in FY 2025-26** as per IRDAI industry disclosures.
**Consumer Grievance Redressal:** IRDAI’s integrated grievance portal **Bima Bharosa** resolved 1,37,361 insurance complaints during the fiscal year with an average resolution turnaround of 8 days.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Health insurance annual premiums crossed ₹1.2 Lakh Crore; IRDAI grievance portal is Bima Bharosa.
